summary: Velo3D filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of 3,571,428 shares of common stock at $14.00 per share, representing gross proceeds of approximately $50 million. The offering is underwritten by Cantor, with a 6.0% underwriting discount. The last sale price on April 24, 2026 was $17.36, indicating a discount to market. This is an ordinary shelf takedown by an operating company to raise capital; there is no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This filing is a routine capital markets transaction and not a special situation.
